capabilities: Edit, add, rename, reorder, and delete top-level YAML properties in a popup
Manage list values such as tags and aliases individually
Create path-matched property templates and merge them into notes
Suggest pinned, recent, and vault-discovered categories and values
Detect concurrent frontmatter changes before writing
extras: Writes only the active note in version 1.0.0; multi-note editing is a roadmap item. Warns that Obsidian may normalize YAML formatting when saving and recommends testing in a separate vault.
problem: Obsidian has no focused interface for editing frontmatter properties without hand-editing raw YAML.
summary: Popup editor for creating, reordering, and reusing YAML frontmatter properties in the active note, with templates and suggestions.
